summary_1line: Suka attains liberation and answers Vyasa as a cosmic echo; later Yudhishthira asks Bhishma profound questions about the deity and path to emancipation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vyasa stands on a mountain calling for Suka while the entire universe echoes the single syllable 'Bho' across caves and peaks.
Apsaras bathing in the celestial Mandakini suddenly dive into the water or rush to the groves in shame as the grieving sage Vyasa appears.
Shiva surrounded by gods and Gandharvas appears before the sorrowful Vyasa seated on a mountain and consoles him about his liberated son.
